blocks.old: Have you done years of CBT or EMDR and yet you still freeze up or blow up at the same old triggers? One reason to think about, is that standard therapy is trying to rewrite the "code" (your thoughts and behaviors), while the "motherboard" (the brain's physical structure and chemistry) is often overheating or damaged, and code doesn't run well on a motherboard like that. So to address that, I've designed this protocol to go after four specific neuro-biological problems before you go working on the psychology (well, alongside).

blocks.old: As we grow up, our "Role-Self" becomes calcified by Dopamine and DeltaFosB. It becomes a prison. Your addiction is often just the fuel required to keep the "Role-Self" running. This protocol dissolves the chemical glue holding that false persona together, allowing your "True-Self"--the person you were before the trauma--to finally re-emerge.
blocks.new: We grew up building a "role-self" to please and manage the people around us. And the role-self psychology gets locked in physiologically by Dopamine and DeltaFosB, which also underlie addictions, so it's a vicious cycle as both create the other. That's why I built this protocol, to go after the chemistry holding the false persona in place, so the person you were before the trauma (your "True-Self") can come back out.
